name: premium-hud-shop-readability
description: Verify actual next-action text, coherent rarity colors, distinct equipped status and active Equip controls, and full-screen Inventory dimmer across desktop and phone sizes.

args.code: local S=game:GetService('StudioDeviceSimulatorService')local H=game.HttpService assert(workspace:GetAttribute('SmashPremiumUIOwnedDevice')==nil)local id=S:CreateDeviceAsync({Name='Smash Premium UI '..H:GenerateGUID(false),Width=1277,Height=720,PixelDensity=96,DeviceForm=Enum.DeviceForm.Desktop})workspace:SetAttribute('SmashPremiumUIOwnedDevice',id)S:SetDeviceAsync(id)S:SetScalingModeAsync(Enum.DeviceSimulatorScalingMode.FitToWindow)return H:JSONEncode({ok=true})

local H=game.HttpService local p=game.Players:GetPlayers()[1]assert(p:GetAttribute('ProfileWritable')==false and p:GetAttribute('ProfilePersistenceState')=='EphemeralStudio')local a=game.ServerStorage.PunchWallAutomation assert(a:Invoke('Reset').ok)local s=a:Invoke('SetStats',{Power=15,Coins=1000,Depth=1,OwnedFistsJSON=H:JSONEncode({'Starter Glove','Boxing Glove'})})assert(s.ok)return H:JSONEncode({ok=true})

steps.label: seed owned and equipped action states

args.code:
local H=game.HttpService local S=game:GetService('StudioDeviceSimulatorService')local p=game.Players.LocalPlayer local g=p.PlayerGui.PunchWallHUD local a=g.PunchWallClientAutomation local style=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.PolishConfig)local id=assert(workspace:GetAttribute('SmashPremiumUIOwnedDevice'))local rows={}
local function shown(x)local n=x while n do if n:IsA('GuiObject')and not n.Visible then return false end n=n.Parent end return true end
local function inside(x,area)local p,s=x.AbsolutePosition,x.AbsoluteSize local o,v=area.AbsolutePosition,area.AbsoluteSize return p.X>=o.X-1 and p.Y>=o.Y-1 and p.X+s.X<=o.X+v.X+1 and p.Y+s.Y<=o.Y+v.Y+1 end
local function textFits(t)assert(t.Text~='' and t.TextBounds.X>0 and t.TextBounds.Y>0 and t.TextFits,'unreadable '..t:GetFullName())end
for _,spec in ipairs({{1277,720,1},{874,402,.8},{874,402,1.2},{360,740,1}})do
local info=S:GetDeviceInfoAsync(id)S:UpdateDeviceAsync(id,{Name=info.Name,Width=spec[1],Height=spec[2],PixelDensity=96,DeviceForm=Enum.DeviceForm.Desktop})S:SetDeviceAsync(id)S:SetScalingModeAsync(Enum.DeviceSimulatorScalingMode.FitToWindow)
a:Invoke('SetSettings',{uiScale=spec[3],motion=true,sound=true})a:Invoke('CloseMenus')task.wait(.6)
local objective=g.PixelPerfectHeroCityHUD:FindFirstChild('ObjectiveText',true)assert(objective and shown(objective))textFits(objective)assert(objective:FindFirstChildOfClass('UITextSizeConstraint').MinTextSize>=14 and inside(objective,g.PixelPerfectHeroCityHUD),'objective text floor/bounds')
assert(a:Invoke('OpenTab','Fists')==true)task.wait(.5)local shop=g.GameMenu.FunctionalHeroShop assert(shop.Visible and g.HeroShopDimmer.Visible)
local cards=0 for _,card in ipairs(shop:GetDescendants())do if card:IsA('Frame')and card:GetAttribute('ShopCardLayout')then
cards+=1 local name=card:FindFirstChild('Name')assert(name and name:FindFirstChildOfClass('UITextSizeConstraint').MinTextSize>=14)textFits(name)
end end assert(cards>=16,'missing actual fist catalog')
for _,entry in ipairs({{'Starter Glove','Common'},{'Boxing Glove','Common'},{'Iron Knuckle','Rare'},{'Thunder Fist','Epic'}})do local c=assert(shop:FindFirstChild(entry[1]..'ShopCard',true))assert(c.Rarity.TextColor3==style.RarityColors[entry[2]],'inconsistent rarity color')end
local starter=shop:FindFirstChild('Starter GloveAction',true)local equip=shop:FindFirstChild('Boxing GloveAction',true)assert(starter and equip and not starter.Active and equip.Active and starter.Text=='EQUIPPED' and equip.Text=='EQUIP','status/action distinction lost')assert(starter.BackgroundColor3~=equip.BackgroundColor3 and starter.TextColor3~=equip.TextColor3,'status looks actionable')for _,button in ipairs({starter,equip,shop.ShopHeader.CloseShop})do textFits(button)assert(button.AbsoluteSize.X>=44 and button.AbsoluteSize.Y>=44,'small control '..button.Name)end
assert(a:Invoke('OpenInventory').ok)task.wait(.3)assert(g.HeroShopDimmer.Visible,'Inventory needs full viewport dimmer')assert(a:Invoke('CloseMenus')==true)assert(not g.HeroShopDimmer.Visible,'dimmer persisted after close')
table.insert(rows,{width=spec[1],height=spec[2],scale=spec[3],catalogCards=cards})
end return H:JSONEncode({ok=true,rows=rows})

steps.label: audit rendered objective and catalog controls across device sizes
